references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native species: coral-red translucent crystal formation. Keep coral-red hue; do NOT copy the spidery-arch shape.
Shipped catalog immovable/crystal: round dense purple starburst cluster. The red crystal must be an elongated horizontal blade fan, not round.

prompt_fields.subject: A horizontal fan of five long jagged blade-like opaque crystal shards of different lengths, all rooted in one small rocky boss at the left and spreading toward the right and slightly upward like a spray of swords, sharp asymmetric tips, flat lit facets and darker shaded facets. Elongated left-to-right silhouette that stays low; the longest shard tip stops well inside the inner four-fifths of the disc. Solid opaque facets, no transparency, no glow.
prompt_fields.contrast: Family of immovable/crystal with spellblaze-crystal (round purple cluster), white crystal (tall vertical central-spire bouquet, palest) and crimson crystal (two thick blocky prisms, darker). The red crystal is the long horizontal many-blade fan: silhouette (thin horizontal blades) and value (bright mid-value coral red) separate it from the others, not hue alone.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Bright coral-red and orange-red crystal facets with pale pink-orange lit edges and deeper red shaded planes, small grey-brown rocky root; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
